rules.instruction: Maintain continuous meaningful scene-specific visual development during speech; do not use repetitive generic card pulses or unrelated decorative movement as a substitute.
rules.source: user feedback on previous full video

rules.instruction: Write spoken English technical terms in their conventional English spelling in subtitles while keeping Bangla text in Bangla.

rules.instruction: Do not read long token strings, code, or screen-only data aloud unless explicitly requested.

rules.instruction: Align visual beats and subtitles to real narration evidence; never claim estimated or automated timing is human-verified.
